pages.text: A LABEL block holds a name.$(br2)Labels name programs, functions, variables and more. A name uses a-z, A-Z, 0-9 and the underscore, and it starts with a letter. Keywords in capitals are reserved: $(1)RESULT$() is not a valid name, but $(1)result$() is.
A label can point into a value with an index, like $(1)list[0]$(), $(1)stock["gold"]$() or $(1)problem.code$(). Right-click the block with an empty hand to enter the name and the index.
Craft a NOOP block and a paper together.
All three $(1)score$() blocks are LABEL blocks. The first names the variable, the others refer to it.
